title: Verify: Backend config LoadFS and healthz unit tests
summary: Add Go unit tests for LoadFS via fstest.MapFS and NewRouter healthz via httptest.
description:
Context: ACT-BE added LoadFS and NewRouter without tests.
Desired behavior: Unit-test config decoding and /healthz with MapFS and httptest; no live server Listen.
Expected result: go test filtered to LoadFS and NewRouter tests passes.
Why: Proves REQ-BE config and wiring ACs with mocked FS/HTTP.
acceptance_criteria: Given MapFS containing valid YAML, when LoadFS reads config.yaml, then Addr is :8080 and RepoPath is .
Given MapFS missing server.addr, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a non-nil error.
Given NewRouter, when httptest GET /healthz, then status is 200 and body is ok.
definition_of_done: Unit tests exist and filtered go test commands pass

steps.action: Create TestLoadFS_Success using fstest.MapFS with file config.yaml content matching example (server.addr :8080, git.repo_path .); assert LoadFS returns nil error and those field values. Create TestLoadFS_MissingAddr with YAML missing addr; assert error != nil. Package main.
Create TestNewRouter_Healthz that does httptest.NewRequest GET /healthz, serves via NewRouter, asserts status 200 and body ok. Package main.
steps.expected: TestNewRouter_Healthz passes without listening on a real port.
